long_biography.plain_text:
The Spanish industrial chemist Francisco Javier Sitges Menéndez helped make zinc extraction more efficient. With Vicente Arregui, he developed the jarosite process at Asturiana de Zinc, substantially increasing the amount of metal recovered from its ore. The innovation became a widely used part of zinc production and generated royalties for the company.

Sitges continued developing practical equipment for metal production. He co-invented a cathode designed to make deposited zinc easier to detach, working with colleagues who included his brother Fernando. He also served on the Prince of Asturias Award jury for technical and scientific research, helping select work for recognition beyond his own industry.
